transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, uh... people say my talking gets all mixed up. Like, I try to explain about the keys for work, and then... then the jail, and the prayer rug, maybe the chess pieces. And they just tell me they can't follow what I'm saying. So... that's why I'm here, I guess.
Do you feel like your thoughts are jumbled or hard to organize in your head before you try to express them?
I guess. Like I was just saying... I try to explain about the keys, and it just gets all mixed up when I talk. I know what I mean, but... they just tell me they can't follow it. I don't know.
Do you ever feel like the things you're thinking about aren't really happening or aren't real?

I... I don't know about "not real." I just know what I see. Like at work. I clean the building, and... I know the people there marked me. They use the hallway lights. Flicking them. And they give each other these little looks when I walk by. To warn each other. My supervisor... he pulled up the security camera to show me there was nothing there, but... I know what I saw. I'm sure of it.
Do you ever hear voices or sounds that other people can't hear?

Yeah... sometimes. Just... a voice. It's a man's voice. Usually when I'm working, like... coming from the vents. Or the mop closet. He says my name. Or he tells me... tells me I ruined everything. It's loud. Like... like he's standing right there next to me.
When you hear the voice, do you think it's really coming from the vents or the mop closet, or does it feel like it's just in your head?
It's... it's real. It's coming from the vents. Or... wherever. It's not in my head. It sounds just like... like you talking to me right now. Just... a real guy. Standing right there.
How long have you been experiencing these thoughts and hearing the voice?
It's been... I don't know, maybe a year and a half. Yeah. About a year and a half since the voice started... and since I noticed them watching me and marking me.
Do you have trouble completing tasks or daily activities because of your thoughts or the voice you hear?

Yeah... it's hard. I miss shifts sometimes. Or... I lose jobs. People say I'm... they say I'm not reliable. Or they don't know what I'm talking about. So I just... I don't go out much anymore. Not to the mosque. Not with my family. It's just... better that way. Sometimes things get bad and... people have to call an ambulance or something. It's just hard to keep up.
Do you have difficulty taking care of your personal hygiene or appearance?

Sometimes... yeah. On the bad days. I just... I sit on the edge of the bed after morning prayer. Just... feeling heavy. Empty. Like there's... there's just no point. No point in cleaning myself up or going outside. So I don't.
Do you have trouble behaving appropriately in social situations or at work?
I don't know... I guess so. People get upset with me. I just try to stay out of the way.
Can you tell me more about what happens on the days when you just sit on the edge of the bed and don't take care of yourself?

I just... I already said. I finish my prayers and... I just sit there. It's... I don't know. Just heavy. Like I'm empty inside. There's just... no reason to get up and wash. No reason to go out. So I just stay there.
Do you find yourself acting strangely or doing things that don't make sense to others?
I don't... I don't really know what you mean by that. I just... I keep to myself mostly. I just do my job and go home. I don't think I do anything strange.
Can you think of any times when you did something that seemed normal to you, but other people thought was strange or didn't understand why you were doing it?
No... I can't really think of anything. Like I said, I just keep to myself. If people think I'm doing something weird, they don't tell me. I just... I do my cleaning and that's it.
Do you have periods of time where you feel completely normal and none of these things are happening?

I guess... there are times when it's not so heavy. And I'm not... wound up. Just normal, I suppose. But... even then... even for a few weeks like that... I still hear him. The man in the vents. And... I know they're still signaling each other about me. That part doesn't stop.
Have you ever done anything that seemed normal to you at the time, but looking back, you're not really sure why you did it?
I... no. I don't think so. I just... I do my work. I don't really think about it like that.
Have you lost any friends or had problems with your family because of the things you've been experiencing?

I... yeah. I guess I don't see them much anymore. I stopped going to family gatherings... and the mosque, too. They say they can't understand me. Or that they can't rely on me. 

It's... it's the same with my work. I've missed shifts. I lost some of my cleaning jobs because of it. And... well, sometimes it gets bad enough that people have had to call for emergency help. Because they said I wasn't safe. But... I don't really want to talk about that part.
Can you describe a specific time when you did something that seemed normal to you, but others thought was strange or out of place?

I... I don't really know what you mean. I just... I do my work. I clean the buildings. I don't think I do strange things. People just... they don't understand me, that's all. I just want to do my job.
Can you think of any times when you did something that seemed normal to you, but looking back, it doesn't make sense to you now?
I... no. I already said, I don't really know. I just... I go to work. I don't sit around thinking about everything I've done. I just do what I need to do.
Have you ever had a period of time where you didn't hear the voice or feel like you were being watched?

I... no. Not really. They don't stop. 

The voice... and knowing they're watching me. It's been with me for... I don't know, maybe a year and a half now. It just stays like that.
Have you ever done anything that seemed normal to you at the time, but looking back, you're not really sure why you did it or it seemed out of character for you?
I... I don't think so. I don't know why you keep asking me that. I just... I go to work and I come home. I don't do things that are out of character. I'm just me.
Have your symptoms gotten worse over the past year and a half?
I don't know. It's just... it's just been the same, I guess. It doesn't really change.
